_provenance.proof_scope: proves that a reader-shaped partial-ASR receipt folds into a media-pending checkpoint that is not finished and whose resume routing is a range read; does not prove transcription quality, cue timing, duplicate avoidance, or resume after a real process interruption
_provenance.note: Real receipt from reader.read_public_page (video source, no subtitles, local ASR) with transcribe_audio_file monkeypatched to a partial result: 120 s processed of 3600 s. The text modality covers every character it has (delivered_chars=3818, total_chars=3818), so the v1 rule (remaining_chars() == 0 and state in {PARTIAL, CHECKPOINTED, RESUMING}) evaluates to True for this receipt: that rule is the bug that let 120 s of 3600 s count as finished. Under checkpoint v2 the same fold gives media_pending()=True and is_finished()=False.
